messages:
alex: Heads-up: customer LedgerPay on Dedicated-3 reporting widespread 429s since 09:12UTC. Platform shows KV eviction spikes and memory fragmentation. Repro attached.
sara: Which tenant id and region?
alex: tenant=ledgerpay-prod (tid_87B). region=us-west-2. First 429 spike 09:12:03 -> lasted ~6m.
alex: logs snippet:
```
09:12:02 [svc] request id=abc123 status=200 tokens=512 user=ledgerpay
09:12:03 [svc] request id=abc124 status=429 reason=kv_throttle kv_evictions=183 active_kv_mem=62GB
09:12:04 [runtime] kv_evict loop: evicted=120 pref=prefix_longctx user=ledgerpay
```
sara: @eng-oncall can you check KV fragmentation and per-slot pressure? Any recent model rollouts?
eng-oncall: Confirmed KV pressure on Dedicated-3 pool (p3x). Top offenders are long-context endpoints from ledgerpay creating many large prefix keys (32k histories). Allocator fragmentation is up — can't find contiguous chunks -> increased evictions and retries.
kevin: Also seeing a hot prefix pattern: `ledgerpay:chat:session:` with many active sessions; append-only writes causing poor locality.
iris_support: Customer reports latency jump from ~70ms -> 600-800ms and billing us for retry storms. They want mitigation ASAP.
eng-oncall: Short term mitigations: enable per-tenant eviction grace (reduce min_kv_reserve), bump pool autoscale target +20% to relieve pressure, and create a temporary shard for `ledgerpay:chat` to isolate their hot keys.
alex: Repro script I used (local load test):
```bash
#!/bin/bash
for i in {1..500}; do
  curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n    -d '{"model":"rwx-10b-longctx","input":"<rep 1000 words>","tenant":"tid_87B"}' &
done
wait
```
kevin: Recommend scheduling a KV compaction job to coalesce small fragments; will target Dedicated-3 tonight. Also adding a short-term quota on max-session-history length for this tenant.
sara: Can support push a TTL/policy tweak for this tenant and notify LedgerPay before changes?
iris_support: Scheduling a call with LedgerPay for 16:00 PST. I'll ask them to run the repro during the call and collect heap/kv metrics. I'll open a ticket and attach logs.
alex: I'll apply the autoscale bump and monitor. Posting metrics after the change. :eyes:
support-bot: INC-2026 created for ledgerpay kv-throttle, priority=high, owner=eng-oncall
sara: Follow-ups: run compaction, shard prefix for hot keys, autoscale bump, TTL tweak. Linking action items to INC-2026 and will update after the call.
